source: Yahoo Finance via yfinance (auto_adjust=False, actions=True: Adj Close, Close, Stock Splits, Volume); universe and sectors from Wikipedia 'List of S&P 500 companies' (current list)

rules.invalid_returns: E009: return set to NaN where |adj return| > 20% and the adj return and raw-close return have opposite signs (mis-adjusted corporate action)
rules.invalid_returns_exemption: E010: an E009-flagged return is restored if Yahoo records a split on that ticker and date AND raw_close/adj_close changes that day by the split factor within 2%
rules.signal_prices: signal_close = first adj_close chained with returns, invalid returns counted as 0%
